exercises.title: Ways to learn English (Lead-in)
exercises.instruction: Match pictures 1–8 with the ways of learning.

items.explanation: use a dictionary — tra từ điển.

items.right: talk to people whose first language is English
items.explanation: talk to people whose first language is English — nói chuyện với người bản ngữ tiếng Anh.
listen to songs in English — nghe nhạc tiếng Anh.

items.right: write an email to a friend
items.explanation: write an email to a friend — viết email cho bạn.
keep a vocabulary notebook — ghi sổ từ vựng.

items.right: study with a teacher in a classroom
items.explanation: study with a teacher in a classroom — học với giáo viên trên lớp.
watch videos online — xem video trên mạng.

exercises.title: Prepositions with communication verbs (Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition.

items.prompt: Can you phone me when you are free? I need to talk ____ you.
items.explanation: talk to sb = nói chuyện với ai.

items.prompt: When you apply for a job, I think it is best to communicate ____ email first.
items.explanation: communicate by email = liên lạc bằng email (by + phương tiện).

items.prompt: The weather is a popular topic to talk ____ in the UK.
items.explanation: talk about + chủ đề. (Lưu ý: discuss KHÔNG cần giới từ — discuss the weather.)

items.prompt: Whenever I visit your home, they always chat ____ me.
items.explanation: chat with sb = tán gẫu với ai.

items.prompt: I know enough of the language to hold a conversation ____ someone.
items.explanation: hold a conversation with sb = duy trì cuộc trò chuyện với ai.

exercises.title: Match the question halves (Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Match the two halves of the questions.

items.left: What is the main language that
items.explanation: What is the main language that + you speak in your country? (mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho language).
communicate + by phone or by email (by + phương tiện liên lạc).
How often do you talk + to people on the internet? (talk to sb).
What do you usually chat + about…? (chat about sth — giới từ ở cuối câu hỏi).
Do you think reading newspapers + can help with language learning? (help with sth).

items.right: with a teacher in a classroom.
items.explanation: study with a teacher in a classroom.

items.right: to people whose first language is English.

use a dictionary.

items.explanation: make an effort = nỗ lực.

items.explanation: do some work = làm việc/học bài.

items.explanation: have fun = vui vẻ.

items.explanation: speak a language = nói một ngôn ngữ.

exercises.title: Summarise the main ideas (Ex. 17)
exercises.instruction: Read the text about Richard Doner again and choose the correct word to summarise the main idea.

items.prompt: Richard Doner is very special because he can speak ____ languages…
items.explanation: So sánh hơn với than (…than most people) → more languages.

items.prompt: …than ____ people.
items.explanation: most people = hầu hết mọi người (không có "of" khi không có the/my…).

items.explanation: Đáp án sách: lots of.

items.explanation: Đáp án sách: regularly (đều đặn).

exercises.title: A conversation about Susan's brother (G&V Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Complete the conversation with: time, advantage, skills, advice, effort, progress, fun, work.

items.prompt: My brother says he won't be able to pass his English exam, so he's not going to make an ____. — Well, he never does any ____.
items.explanation: make an effort = cố gắng; do work = làm bài/học.

items.prompt: I tried to give him some ____, but he didn't take it. He only wants to have ____.
items.explanation: give advice = cho lời khuyên; have fun = chơi vui.

items.prompt: I told him that it takes a long ____ to learn a language.
items.explanation: it takes a long time = mất nhiều thời gian.

items.prompt: He should also practise his speaking ____ as well as listening. It's more difficult to make any ____ if you don't speak.
items.explanation: speaking skills = kỹ năng nói; make progress = tiến bộ.

items.prompt: He also has a big ____ because your dad is an English teacher!
items.explanation: have an advantage = có lợi thế (vì bố là giáo viên tiếng Anh).

exercises.title: Paraphrase the conversation (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences that paraphrase the conversation in the previous exercise. Write ONE to THREE words.

items.prompt: Susan's brother isn't going to study because he believes he is going to fail ____.
items.explanation: Hội thoại: em trai nói sẽ không đỗ bài thi tiếng Anh → fail his English exam.

items.prompt: He didn't want to take Susan's ____.
items.explanation: Câu gốc: I tried to give him some advice, but he didn't take it → take Susan's advice.

items.prompt: Susan's brother isn't interested in his studies and he would much rather ____.
items.explanation: He only wants to have fun → would rather have fun.

items.prompt: George told Susan's brother that it takes a lot of effort to learn a language, and it happens over a ____.
items.explanation: it takes a long time → happens over a long time.

items.prompt: George thinks that without practising your speaking skills, it is more difficult to ____.
items.explanation: It's more difficult to make any progress if you don't speak.

items.prompt: The biggest advantage that Susan's brother has is that their father teaches ____.
items.explanation: Lợi thế: bố là giáo viên tiếng Anh → their father teaches English.

exercises.title: Sentences about plans (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Look again at the five sentences in "Plans (Ex. 5)" and answer the questions.

items.prompt: How do we know the writer is talking about future plans?

items.explanation: Các trạng từ trong bài: tonight, this afternoon, next week, today, this morning, at the weekend.

exercises.title: Correct or incorrect? (Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Choose the CORRECT sentence.

items.prompt: A plan to study in the UK at 18:

options.text: When I am 18, I going to study in the UK.
When I am 18, I am going to study in the UK.

items.explanation: Thiếu "am".

items.prompt: An invitation to go shopping later:

options.text: Are you going to come shopping with me later?
You going to come shopping with me later?

items.explanation: Câu hỏi với going to phải đảo be: Are you going to…?

items.prompt: Her plan to buy a new phone:

options.text: She is going buy a new smartphone at the weekend.
She is going to buy a new smartphone at the weekend.

items.explanation: Thiếu "to".

items.prompt: A question about telling your parents:

options.text: You are going to tell your parents that you got bad results?
Are you going to tell your parents that you got bad results?

items.explanation: Câu hỏi phải đảo are lên trước.

items.prompt: A question about where to watch the match:

options.text: Where are you going to watch the football match?
Where you are going to watch the football match?

items.explanation: Wh- + be + S + going to: Where are you going to watch…? (không giữ trật tự câu khẳng định).

items.prompt: Not ordering food at the restaurant:

options.text: I'm not going to order any food at the restaurant – I'm not hungry.
I'm going not to order any food at the restaurant – I'm not hungry.

items.explanation: Câu trong sách đã đúng: not đứng ngay sau am.

exercises.title: Positive, negative and questions (G&V Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Write the correct form of going to (+ / − / ?).

items.prompt: (−/I/worry) ____ about my English test tomorrow. It is only a practice test.

exercises.title: Questions with going to (G&V Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order to make questions.

items.explanation: Wh- + are + you + going to + V…; giới từ with đứng cuối (do the project with sb).

exercises.instruction: Put the parts of the essay in the correct order (A: disadvantages paragraph · B: conclusion · C: introduction · D: advantages paragraph).

exercises.title: An essay about online dictionaries (Ex. 24–25)
exercises.instruction: Read the student's essay and choose the correct answer for each gap.

stimulus.text:
Many students use an online dictionary to help them learn a language when they study in class. In this essay, I (1) ____ discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this.

Firstly, if a student doesn't (2) ____ the meaning of a word or phrase, they can find it quickly and easily with an online dictionary. The teacher can continue with the class and doesn't need to stop and answer questions all the time. Furthermore, a paper dictionary is sometimes too heavy and students don't like to carry one in their bags.

On the other hand, when a student is not very confident, or if they are afraid of (3) ____ a mistake, they might start to use their dictionary in the wrong way. If they stop to (4) ____ every word or phrase they do not know, they won't (5) ____ their language skills enough and they won't improve. Additionally, it is very difficult for a teacher to check that the students are (6) ____ their computers to look (7) ____ a word and not just playing online games. If they do not focus on the class, they won't (8) ____ any progress.

To sum up, an online dictionary is often useful for students. However, in my opinion, students should only go online when the teacher says to do so. If not, they won't learn for themselves.
stimulus.caption: What are the advantages and disadvantages of using an online dictionary in a language class?

items.prompt: (1) In this essay, I ____ discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this.
items.explanation: Dạng đầy đủ: S + am going to + V → I am going to discuss.

items.prompt: (2) if a student doesn't ____ the meaning of a word
items.explanation: know the meaning of a word = biết nghĩa của từ.

items.prompt: (3) if they are afraid of ____ a mistake
items.explanation: make a mistake.

items.prompt: (4) If they stop to ____ every word or phrase they do not know
items.explanation: stop to check every word = dừng lại để tra từng từ.

items.prompt: (5) they won't ____ their language skills enough
items.explanation: practise their language skills = luyện kỹ năng ngôn ngữ.

items.prompt: (6) check that the students are ____ their computers
items.explanation: are + V-ing (hiện tại tiếp diễn): are using their computers.

items.prompt: (7) to look ____ a word
items.explanation: look up = tra cứu.

items.prompt: (8) they won't ____ any progress
items.explanation: make progress = tiến bộ.

exercises.title: What are linking words used for? (Ex. 26)
exercises.instruction: Put the linking words into groups by function.

items.explanation: Firstly = trước hết → mở ý chính thứ nhất.
Furthermore = hơn nữa → bổ sung thông tin.
Additionally = thêm vào đó → bổ sung thông tin.
On the other hand = mặt khác → ý đối lập.
However = tuy nhiên → ý đối lập.
To sum up = tóm lại → kết luận.

exercises.title: Write an essay: classmates from the same country (Ex. 27)
exercises.instruction: Write an essay (220–250 words): "What are the advantages and disadvantages of taking English lessons with classmates from the same country?" Include a clear introduction and conclusion, body paragraphs about the advantages and the disadvantages, and linking words to organise your ideas (Firstly, Furthermore, On the other hand, However, To sum up…).

checklist: Mở bài giới thiệu chủ đề và mục đích bài luận
Một đoạn ưu điểm (ít nhất 2 ý)
Một đoạn nhược điểm (ít nhất 2 ý)
Kết luận có ý kiến cá nhân
Dùng từ nối đúng chức năng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Many students want to learn English, but most of them cannot travel to an English-speaking country. Instead, they study in their own country, in classes where everybody has the same first language. In this essay, I am going to discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this.

Firstly, if a student does not understand a word or the teacher's instructions, a classmate can quickly explain it in their first language. This saves time and helps weaker students feel less worried. Furthermore, the teacher usually knows the typical problems that students from that country have, such as difficult sounds or grammar, so they can focus on these problems in every lesson. Additionally, it is often cheaper to study in your own country than to go abroad.

On the other hand, students may speak their own language too often, especially in group work, so they do not practise their English enough. Shy or lazy students might never try to communicate in English at all. Moreover, if everybody makes the same mistakes, nobody notices them, and the mistakes become habits. Finally, students do not learn about other cultures, which is an important part of learning a language.

To sum up, studying with classmates who share your first language can be helpful, because they can support you with difficult grammar and vocabulary. However, in my opinion, students in this kind of class must be very motivated and should try to use only English in the classroom if they want to make real progress.
commonErrors: Thiếu mở bài hoặc kết luận
Dùng sai từ nối (However để thêm ý)
Quá ít hoặc quá nhiều từ

exercises.title: Speaking: questions about learning languages (Ex. 2, 5)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 15–25 seconds.

items.prompt: Which ways of learning English work best for you? Why?
items.sampleAnswer: Watching videos online works best for me, because I can learn real English and it's fun. I also keep a vocabulary notebook, so I can review new words before tests.

items.prompt: Do you prefer to communicate by phone or by email?
items.sampleAnswer: I prefer to communicate by phone, because it's faster and I can hear the other person's voice. I only use email for school or when I need to send documents.
items.sampleNote: Lựa chọn + lý do + ngoại lệ.

items.prompt: What are you going to do to improve your English next month?
items.sampleAnswer: Next month, I'm going to join an English club at school, and I'm going to read one short book in English. I think speaking with other students will help me become more confident.

exercises.title: Speaking: a language you are learning (Ex. 13–14)
exercises.instruction: Read the task, prepare for one minute, then speak for 1–2 minutes.

items.prompt:
Describe a language that you are studying, other than your first language.
You should say:
• what the language is
• how well you know the language
• how long you are going to study the language for
and explain why you are learning this language.
items.sampleAnswer: The language I'm studying at the moment is English. I started learning it in primary school, so I've studied it for about eight years, but I think my level is only pre-intermediate. I can read simple articles and I can hold a short conversation about everyday topics, but I still find listening quite difficult, especially when people speak fast. I'm going to study English for at least two more years, because I'm going to take the IELTS test before I finish high school. My plan is to practise my skills every day – for example, I'm going to watch one video online and learn ten new words each evening. The main reason I'm learning English is that I want to study abroad, maybe in Australia. Also, English gives you more job opportunities, and it helps me talk to people from all over the world, so I think it's really worth the effort.
items.sampleNote: Đủ 4 ý; dùng going to cho kế hoạch, collocation (hold a conversation, practise my skills, worth the effort), có lý do cụ thể.

exercises.title: Prepositions (G&V Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition (or "no preposition").

exercises.title: MAKE or TAKE? (G&V Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer.

items.prompt: It is a beautiful day. I ____ a walk.
items.explanation: Kế hoạch vừa nảy ra dựa trên tình huống; take a walk = đi dạo → am going to take.

items.prompt: Lucinda is upset. She thinks she ____ many mistakes in the exam.
items.explanation: Bài thi đã qua → quá khứ; make a mistake → made.

items.prompt: Robert is so funny. He really ____ me laugh.
items.explanation: make sb laugh; nói về tính cách chung (luôn vậy) → makes.

items.prompt: I always ____ lots of photos when I go sightseeing on holiday.
items.explanation: take photos; always → hiện tại đơn take.

items.prompt: What really ____ a difference to your language skills is if you don't worry about making mistakes.
items.explanation: make a difference; sự thật chung → makes.

exercises.title: Put the linking words in the right place (G&V Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Five linking words in bold in the text are in the wrong places. Write the correct linking word for each position 1–5 (use: To sum up, firstly, However, Furthermore, Additionally).

items.prompt: I'm going to talk about a project I did at college. (1) ____, it was a language project, and I worked with my friend, Peter.
items.explanation: Ý đầu tiên → Firstly.

items.prompt: We had to find out how many people in college speak more than one language and, (2) ____, what their level of English is.
items.explanation: Thêm một việc nữa phải tìm hiểu → additionally / furthermore.

items.prompt: I like doing this sort of project, so was happy to work hard. (3) ____, Peter is also a very good student, so we helped each other a lot.
items.explanation: Bổ sung thêm ý tích cực → Furthermore / Additionally.

items.prompt: …and it was quite easy in the end. (4) ____, we didn't get any good advice from Miss Smith in the college office.
items.explanation: Chuyển sang ý trái ngược (khó khăn) → However.

items.prompt: …and then she couldn't find the correct information herself! (5) ____, she didn't help us at all.
items.explanation: Câu kết luận → To sum up.

exercises.title: Verb forms (G&V Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the correct form of: have (x2), discuss, hold, communicate, try.

items.prompt: I don't know what university to apply for. My father and I ____ a chat about it tomorrow.
items.explanation: tomorrow (kế hoạch đã định) → are going to have / are having a chat.

items.prompt: Come in, Alison. We ____ to decide what to have for dinner.
items.explanation: Việc đang làm lúc nói → are trying to decide.

items.prompt: Look, we ____ this last week – I don't want to have a party for my birthday.
items.explanation: last week → quá khứ: discussed.

items.prompt: I don't know anyone who ____ by letter anymore.
items.explanation: who + ngôi 3 số ít (anyone) → communicates.

items.prompt: Our English teacher always tells us ____ more conversations with each other after class.
items.explanation: tell sb to + V → to hold more conversations.

items.prompt: I ____ a chat with my mum about what language course to take.
items.explanation: Sách chấp nhận nhiều thì: had / am having / will have / am going to have.
